I'll approximate via calculator mentally: Ln(980) = Ln(1000)-something. Ln(1000)=6.907755278982137. Difference: 1000/980=1.020408..., Ln(1.020408)=approx 0.020203. So Ln(980)=6.907755 - 0.020203 = 6.887552. Good. Now Ln(20)=2.995732274. Division: 6.887552 / 2.995732 = 2.298... Let's compute: 2.995732 * 2.298 = 6.889? Slightly higher.
